text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. This makes the whole team stronger. In addition, regular code reviews improve team quality because everyone follows the same rules and standards. As a result, the final product is cleaner, safer, and easier to maintain. For these reasons, every development team should make code reviews a normal habit.
